newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian insurer sees HRK 40 mln 1997 gross profit.
newsitem.headline: Croatian insurer sees HRK 40 mln 1997 gross profit.

text.p: Croatia's state-owned insurer Croatia Osiguranje said on Monday it planned to lift gross profit to 40 million kuna this year from around 35 million in 1996.
"In 1996, (profit) was eight percent of the capital and we plan it at 40 million kuna, or nine percent of the capital this year," assistant general director Branimir Zekan told Reuters by telephone.
The company posted a premium of 2.2 billion kuna last year, two percent higher than in 1995. It hopes to boost premium a further three percent to 2.26 billion this year, Zekan said.
Croatia Osiguranje controls some 75 percent of the country's insurance market. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
